paragraphs.text: We are looking for a kitchen assistant for our restaurant near the station. Hours are 4 pm to 11 pm, four days a week including one weekend day. Experience is useful but not essential; training is given.
The pay is £11.50 an hour, rising to £12.20 after six months. Staff eat free on shift and receive a uniform. Applicants must be able to work until the end of the year; the post may become permanent.

items.prompt: The job includes work at the weekend.
Pay increases after half a year.
The restaurant is part of a chain.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
